q: Total number of stages in Works Programme
e: 4 — that is the right answer. there are 4 stages in the Works Programme — the programme passes through formulation at division, consolidation at zone, scrutiny at Railway Board, and finally sanction/inclusion in the budget. This staged process keeps it a continuous planning exercise from division to Board. Related fact: the Divisional, Zonal and Board level coordinators for the programme are the Sr.DEN/Coord, CPDE and EDCE/G respectively.

e: The correct answer is None of these. none of the listed labels applies — new works are sanctioned only through the Works Programme process, not as "special works" or standalone new works outside it, and never as works-in-progress. Every new work must enter via the programme's four stages from division to Board. Related fact: the PCE prepares and submits the zonal Works Programme.
